async def run(items):
    for item in await load():
        print(item)
    for group in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        for item in await load(group):
            print(item)
    for item in items:
        def label():
            return item.id
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await read(label())
    a = {
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await read(item) for item in items
    }
    b = {item:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await read(item) for item in items
    }
